title: Before The Hawthorns: Stoney Lane.
deck: The ground Albion left, with an emphatic farewell.
imageNote: The 1892 cup-winning side, from the Stoney Lane era.
body: Stoney Lane was the setting for Albion’s late-Victorian years, including the cup-winning era of 1888 and 1892. The move to The Hawthorns in 1900 marked the end of that chapter.

The final season there ended with an 8–0 home victory over Nottingham Forest. The club’s archive records 199 senior Albion games at Stoney Lane, with 113 wins. Looking back beyond the current ground is a reminder that even a football club’s most familiar traditions once had another home.
